notes.title: v3.1 Pre-Release 1.50 is out. (Non-Beta users please read) Check out what's new!
notes.notes:
[p]If you encounter any bugs or issues, reporting them to our Discord server will be the best way to get the support you need. [url="https://discord.gg/PUThpCFByn"]Join our Discord server[/url]
[/p][p]How to Access the Pre-Release?[/p][p]Please visit the link below to switch to the beta branch. v3.1 Pre-Release does [b]NOT[/b] require a DLC to use. [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3330635677"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]Non-Beta Users[/h1][p]This is the the pre-release build before v3.1 is released to all users on the default branch.[/p][p]v3.1 uses a whole new system for profiles, this means that when the update is out, you will have to re-make them in v3.1.

My recommendation is to update to this pre-release (instructions to switch to the pre-release is above) to start getting used to v3.1 and it's changes.[/p][p][/p][h1]Pre-Release 1.50 Release Notes:[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]Updated virtual DualSense data passthrough backend where it wasn't sending rumble/triggers/led to your physical device. We've done multiple tests with native games, and all passthrough options are working as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to Installed Games Banner to use full page as background[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Installed Games profile switching when revert is enabled with multiple controllers. All controllers will switch to the profile set for that game, and if revert is on, it will reapply whatever profile was set for that specific controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Hold/Toggle/Switch for Adaptive Trigger and LED presets in Action Shortcuts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where offline cache timestamp wasn't properly fetched (Ability to view local cache expiration date and manually refresh offline cache while internet is available is coming soon)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed DS Edge internal profile system tuning for USB connections where you wouldn't be able to see the adjusted input in real time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed DS Edge not exiting tuning mode when shutting down app[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed HidHide device list not showing all types of instance paths[/p][/*][*][p]Discord Rich Presence has been fully removed from DSX. If you still see DSX as your playing status on Discord, that's from steam. You can disable it in Discord settings or make sure Steam Now Playing Status is disabled in DSX Settings -> Behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]My Controller navigation button is now grayed out if no controllers are connected to DSX as well as updating icon based on connected/disconnected.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up HidHide backend when hiding/unhiding devices. Device instance paths are now saved to a file when a device is hidden, and removed when no longer hidden. In the case of a crash or some unknown error, if there are still paths, DSX will clear them from HidHide when booting up.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated HidHide Page UI[/p][/*][*][p]Updated translation files[/p][/*][*][p]Misc: Bug fixes and general improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Happy Gaming[/b],[/p][p]- Paliverse[/p][p][/p][h3]Your thoughts help us make DSX even better—if you’ve got a minute, a quick Steam review would mean a lot.[/h3]

notes.title: v2.5.0 Released | v3 Status Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch notes for v2.5.0: [/h2]

In the interest of optimization:
● We've temporarily sidelined shortcuts in this version to address the performance issues in DSX. We realized that they were primarily contributing to the lag and occasional freezing. However, rest assured, we're working to refine and reintroduce them in v3.
● We listened to your feedback regarding Steam Stats/achievements. Recognizing that they weren't high on your priority list, we've taken them out. As a consequence, you'll notice the DSX launcher is now more agile and gets you in-game quicker.

[h2]Current Status: [/h2]

DSX v3 is progressing through its Alpha stage. We have a dedicated team of 10 testers diligently examining the system, spotting any potential issues, and ensuring everything is tuned to perfection.

Yes, we acknowledge there have been several delays, but we are devoted to delivering a product worth your patience. We're still enhancing key features like the Action System and virtual controllers.

Based on our detailed roadmap, many elements are already fully operational. This includes a sleek new user interface, robust support for multiple controllers, and a highly customizable Profile System. The Action System and Controller page interface are also now live, delivering a more intuitive and dynamic user experience.

[h2]Looking Forward: [/h2]

We're not done yet. There's a compelling list of features on the horizon that we're excited to roll out. From optional notifications for changing emulation modes to custom mapping of Gyro/joysticks/touchpad to mouse, and even a system-wide mute button with LED notifications.

In the spirit of community collaboration, we're enhancing ways to share and download profiles and providing improved tools for mod development. Plus, a suite of advanced functions is underway, with an emphasis on user customization and versatility.

As we move closer to our vision for DSX v3, we want to thank our patient and supportive community. Your passion is our driving force. We'll continue to share updates and look forward to delivering an extraordinary gaming experience. 🤘

Best regards from the DSX Dev team,
[b]Paliverse[/b], [b]Nefarius[/b], and [b]Ram[/b]

notes.title: DSX rebuild info & v2.2.8 patch notes, Check out what's new!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone,[/h3]
Updates will slow down as I will be rebuilding DSX from the ground up with a whole new UI. 

[h3]This next gen build will have the following:[/h3]
• Modern Windows 11 based UI with better and easier navigation
• DualShock 4 Support (v1, v2(with USB audio support as well), dongle) (Only official controllers will be supported, no third party)
• Multi-Controller support
• Controller Rebinding
• Adaptive Trigger profiles
• Controller Profiles
• Game Profiles
• Better performance
and more...

Currently building the core/foundation, so stay tuned for more info on its progress, 
join the discord server to get the latest updates/previews, with the first preview already there.
At some point, there will be a beta for this new version when the time comes :)

-----------------

[h3]With that out of the way, here's a little update to quench your thirst!
Patch notes for v2.2.8:[/h3]

[h3]Translations:[/h3]
● Added the following languages:
 - Czech

● Updated the following languages:
 - Traditional Chinese
 - Indonesian
 - Polish

[h3]Shortcuts:[/h3]
● Added System Play/Pause media action
● Added System Previous Track media action
● Added System Next Track media action

[h3]Controller Tab:[/h3]
● Added the new upcoming Controller color named Gray Camouflage releasing in October

[h3]Adaptive Triggers:[/h3]
● Fixed Normal Trigger Mode not resetting instantly if you had another Trigger Mode active prior 

[h3]Mods:[/h3]
● Added new Game Mod named DualSense4Rockstar for GTA5 and RDR2 in Games Tab

[h3]UDP (for Mods):[/h3]
● Added a new instruction type named ResetToUserSettings which will apply the user settings for LED's triggers etc..

 C# example:

 p.instructions[0].type = InstructionType.ResetToUserSettings;
 p.instructions[0].parameters = new object[] { controllerIndex };

Until again,
- Paliverse (Solo dev of DSX)

notes.title: DSX Update v2.0.0 - Changes from the GitHub version
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 2.0[/h1]

The new update will feature many new changes and added features from v1.4.9 (GitHub) shown below:

[h3]New Design[/h3]
DSX has been redesigned from the ground up to make the user experience much more fluid and enjoyable!

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
A ton of bug fixes and improvements

[h3]Touchpad LED Modes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Static Color
[*]Rainbow
[*]Custom
[*]Breathing
[*]Strobing
[*]Battery
[/list] 
[h3]Adaptive Triggers[/h3]
[list]
[*]Applying Trigger modes have been separated for Left Trigger and Right Trigger
[*]Export Triggers implementation:
[list]
[*]Copy to clipboard
[*]Export for Textfile use
[*]Export for UDP use
[/list] 
[/list]
[h3]Controller Vibration[/h3]
Separated from Adaptive triggers list with two modes available:
[list]
[*]Time based - Choose your intensity and time up to 1,000 seconds
[*]Interval based - Choose your intensity/Interval and time up to 1,000 seconds
[/list] 
[h3]Games Tab[/h3]
Games Tab has a mod section with list of mods you can use that works with DSX through either UDP or Textfile method to talk with the controller to have dynamic Adaptive Triggers

[h3]Workshop Tab[/h3]
In a future update, users will be able to view the Workshop Tab to find adaptive trigger profiles submitted by other users, more on this later!

[h3]Stats Tab[/h3]
19 Fun Achievements like Travel Distance of Triggers, Number of button presses combined and more!

Stats Tab is all about viewing your stats and Achievements/Leaderboards.
Three Menus:
[list]
[*]Achievements - View your progress for unlocking all 19 Achievements.
[*]My Stats - View your current Trigger Distance and number of button presses
[*]Leaderboards (Coming in a later update) - View global ranking of Trigger Distance and number of button presses
[/list]

[h3]Shortcuts[/h3]
With shortcuts, you can manually open the Game Bar or turn off the DualSense Controller (BT)

[h3]HidHide[/h3]
HidHIde has now been integrated within DSX again to hide the physical controller

and a lot more...
